existing_tips: "Anställd" (employed) functions as both participle and noun.
Particle verbs: verb + particle (upp, ner, ut, in, av, på). The particle changes the meaning.
Means so bad it can't even be criticized properly.
"Öronbedövande" = ear-deafening. Swedish builds vivid compounds: noun + participle.
